name: meshview
description: Browser viewer for meshcore Arrow forms, with GPU face picking back to the source rows

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/* meshview (meshcore, MIT). Bundles three 0.169.0 (MIT) and apache-arrow 17.0.0 (Apache-2.0). */" --outfile=meshview.js && node build-html.js
